steps.name: editor
steps.command: editjumps generation-eval --model-folder data/pretrain/edit_flows --pairs data/pretrain/oas_homolog_pairs.tsv.gz --n-templates 20 --n-variants 20 --n-steps 50 --holdout-size 200 --ceiling-n 300 --seed 0 --k 3 --clock 40.0 --rate-head linear --q-head fresh --pll-model "" --pll-positions 24 --family-fasta data/interim/seed_families/Anti-SARS-CoV-2_VHH_Ty1.fasta --metrics-path metrics/standard/generation_eval.json

steps.name: evotuned
steps.command: editjumps evotune-baseline --model-folder data/pretrain/esm2_evotuned --family-fasta data/interim/seed_families/Anti-SARS-CoV-2_VHH_Ty1.fasta --train-corpus data/pretrain/evotune_family.train.txt.gz --n-templates 20 --n-variants 20 --mutations 4 --temperature 1.0 --holdout-size 200 --ceiling-n 300 --profile-size 200 --budget-mode realised --max-rounds 8 --seed 0 --k 3 --mutations-from metrics/standard/generation_eval.json --no-forced --metrics-path metrics/standard/evotuned.json

steps.name: evotuned_forced
steps.command: editjumps evotune-baseline --model-folder data/pretrain/esm2_evotuned --family-fasta data/interim/seed_families/Anti-SARS-CoV-2_VHH_Ty1.fasta --train-corpus data/pretrain/evotune_family.train.txt.gz --n-templates 20 --n-variants 20 --mutations 4 --temperature 1.0 --holdout-size 200 --ceiling-n 300 --profile-size 200 --budget-mode realised --max-rounds 8 --seed 0 --k 3 --mutations-from metrics/standard/generation_eval.json --forced --metrics-path metrics/standard/evotuned_forced.json

steps.name: evodiff
steps.command: editjumps evodiff-msa-baseline --family-fasta data/interim/seed_families/Anti-SARS-CoV-2_VHH_Ty1.fasta --mode inpaint --model msa-oa-dm-maxsub --n-templates 20 --n-variants 20 --mutations 4 --holdout-size 200 --ceiling-n 300 --msa-size 256 --n-sequences 64 --selection-type "" --temperature 1.0 --penalty-value 2.0 --device auto --budget-mode realised --max-rounds 8 --seed 0 --k 3 --mutations-from metrics/standard/generation_eval.json --metrics-path metrics/standard/evodiff_msa_baseline.json
